description: Δεδομένα αστικών συγκοινωνιών Π.Ε. Θεσσαλονίκης is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Οργανισμός Συγκοινωνιακού Έργου Θεσαλλονίκης - ΟΣΕΘ ΑΕ. This dataset includes data of city buses of the Regional Unit of Thessaloniki in GTFS (General Transit Feed Specification) format. The data is provided by the Thessaloniki Transport Project Organization (OSETH) and includes information about the urban bus transport network, such as lines, stops, scheduled routes and geographical routes. Coverage: Οργανισμός Συγκοινωνιακού Έργου Θεσαλλονίκης - ΟΣΕΘ ΑΕ. The portal shows the English title as "Urban transport data of the Regional Unit of Thessaloniki" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Οργανισμός Συγκοινωνιακού Έργου Θεσαλλονίκης - ΟΣΕΘ ΑΕ. Its keywords include δρομολόγια, λεωφορεία, αστική συγκοινωνία, gtfs, ΟΣΕΘ, στάσεις. The listing shows 6 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2026-09-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
